","fontFamily":"Microsoft YaHei","fontSize":14,"lineHeight":1.5,"color":"#3E4845","align":["left","top"]}},{"elementId":"ft-mark","elementType":"image","bounds":[56,505,16,16],"src":"media/.huandeng-versions/6b49274a35445235b8ab17f805b83cf3c7f8924630a5ce5ef8455e59aba5faef.png","sourceName":"huandeng.png","fit":{"mode":"contain"}},{"elementId":"ft-label","elementType":"text","bounds":[78,505,600,16],"content":{"text":"HUANDENG / 故事先行：一页从头到尾","fontFamily":"Microsoft YaHei","fontSize":11,"lineHeight":1.3,"color":"#7A8480","align":["left","middle"]}},{"elementId":"ft-pos","elementType":"text","bounds":[824,505,80,16],"content":{"text":"0","fontFamily":"Microsoft YaHei","fontSize":11,"lineHeight":1.3,"color":"#7A8480","align":["right","middle"],"field":"main-position"}}] notes: "这是幻灯里最直接来自“故事先行”的部分。每一页都带一段简短的故事：它为了什么，什么必须保留，这次要改什么。可以把它看成我和 agent 之间的对齐工具。右边是这份介绍里 1BNA 那一页实际记录的故事：数值保持不变，保留有标签的坐标轴和单位，保留引用，不作重复实验或趋势的说法。agent 被要求整理这一页时，会先读这些。整个项目、每个章节、每场演讲也都有自己的故事。agent 写下的故事是它的理解，不等于我认可。"
